methods.label: Remove the higher scores
methods.explanation:
The \(50\) students who scored at least \(80\%\) fall into two separate groups: those scoring less than \(90\%\), and those scoring at least \(90\%\). The second group contains \(13\) students, including anyone who scored exactly \(90\%\). Removing that group leaves exactly the students requested:
\[
50-13=37.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{37}\) students, choice \(\text{D}\).
